from flask import Flask, request, make_response

app = Flask(__name__)

@app.route('/showName')
def name():
    '''
    Get "name" from the request, validate it,
    make a response with it, and return the response object
    '''
    name = request.args.get('name')
    
    if not name:
        response = make_response("Missing name parameter", 400)
        return response
    
    if not isinstance(name, str) or len(name.strip()) == 0:
        response = make_response("Invalid name parameter", 400)
        return response
    
    name = name.strip()
    response = make_response(f"Name: {name}", 200)
    return response
